title.narrative: Provision of WASH Assistance in hard-to-reach Communities and health facilities of Magumeri LGA, Borno State

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="" lang="EN-US"gtThe objective of the proposed project is “to provide inclusive, safe,nbspdignified and accessible humanitarian WASH assistance to the most vulnerable IDPs, host communities in hard-to-reach areas and health facilities of Magumeri LGA in Borno State, Northeast Nigeria.” In line with the NHF objective, the action will target geographic areas in which people have had no or limited access to humanitarian WASH assistance in Magumeri LGA. The specific objective of the action is to contribute to improving the living conditions and dignity of people affected by the persistent armed conflict between non-state armed groups and government forces in Magumeri LGA. High humanitarian needs persist in all sectors in Borno state which remains most heavily affected by the conflict. The limitations of movement in hard-to-reach areas pose great challenges for the delivery of assistance and for people in need of accessing aid. For this reason, the action focuses on rural hard-to-reach areas in Magumeri LGA. The project will enhance access to humanitarian assistance by providing basic WASH needs to highly vulnerable people and communities.lt/spangtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gt Operating in Magumeri LGA with an experienced WASH program team that has been present in the LGA for 7 years, JDPC will raise awareness on hygiene behaviour and sensitize communities on the risks and dangers of WASH-related diseases and support equitable access to sufficient water through construction of new water facilities and rehabilitation of existing ones, provide dignified and adequate sanitation facilities (showers, latrines, and disposal sites), and distribution of hygiene and cholera preparedness kits.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gt In this project, JDPC will engage in the 2023 rainy season preparedness support, cholera outbreak and other Emergency WASH activities that will address acute and emerging needs. People targeted will play an active part in the project planning and implementation, hence strengthening their capacity through trainings.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif font-size: 8pt"gtIn this project, JDPC will engage in the 2023 rainy season preparedness support, cholera outbreak and other Emergency WASH activities that will address acute and emerging needs. People targeted will play an active part in the project planning and implementation, hence strengthening their capacity through trainings as well as mainstreaming protection and GBV activities for WASH Committees in IDP camp, host communities and health facilities. JDPC will carry out construction, rehabilitation, Operation and Maintenance (OM) of WASH facilities, water quality testing, improved waste management and establishment of WASH Committees and authorities to operate, repair and manage WASH facilities. lt/spangtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif font-size: 8pt"gtnbsplt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gtThe provision of this WASH assistance will enable the targeted population to have easy access tlt/spangtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gto portable water, improve their hygiene knowledge and practice, and reduce, mitigate and prevent WASH-related diseases in the communities.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgt
